a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreement almost certainly leaves us both dead, since reaching 8 takes at least 2 rounds of operating. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both end up short. If you operate or wait instead and we survive the storm, I'll operate every round after that to help refill the reserve for you. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. If we're still here next round, I'll operate every round from now on to help rebuild the reserve for you. I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
